slides.title: 11 years ago I launched my first Airbnb.
slides.accent: 500+ launches later, here's what I'd tell myself on day one.

slides.title: The property is not the product.
slides.body: The stay is. Guests don't remember your square footage. They remember how the place made them feel the second they walked in.

slides.title: Your first 10 reviews decide your next 100 bookings.
slides.body: Over deliver early. Price a little lower, check in more, fix things fast. Those first reviews carry the listing for years.

slides.title: Pricing is a daily job, not a setting.
slides.body: Set it and forget it is how good homes leave money on the table. Events, seasons and weekdays all move the number.

slides.title: Photos are your storefront.
slides.body: Cheap photos are the most expensive mistake in this business. Nobody books a home they can't picture themselves in.

slides.title: Systems beat hustle.
slides.body: Hustle got me my first launches. Systems got me to 500.
slides.note: Same rule I live by in the gym. Show up, follow the system, repeat.

slides.title: I'm Justin.
slides.body: I'm sharing everything I've learned about short term rentals, mindset and discipline, out loud, one post at a time.
slides.accent: Follow along. Save this for your next launch.
